function.arguments: {"analyst": "Observed strong mixes (mix-414 at 79.99 MPa, mix-370 at 74.5 MPa) have water/binder near 0.25-0.30 with high binder content, while weak mixes (mix-036, mix-149) have high water and low cement, so low-ratio, high-binder menu entries look most promising, though the evidence is confounded and the model estimates are uncertain.", "candidate_ids": ["C01", "C02", "C03", "C05", "C06", "C08", "C07"], "evidence_ids": ["mix-414", "mix-370", "mix-149"], "hypothesis": "Menu mixes with water/binder below about 0.32 and cement of 350 kg/m3 or more, with or without slag, will reach measured 28-day strength above 55 MPa, with the cement-only and slag-blend variants differing by under 5 MPa."}

input.analyst: Observed strong mixes (mix-414 at 79.99 MPa, mix-370 at 74.5 MPa) have water/binder near 0.25-0.30 with high binder content, while weak mixes (mix-036, mix-149) have high water and low cement, so low-ratio, high-binder menu entries look most promising, though the evidence is confounded and the model estimates are uncertain.
input.hypothesis: Menu mixes with water/binder below about 0.32 and cement of 350 kg/m3 or more, with or without slag, will reach measured 28-day strength above 55 MPa, with the cement-only and slag-blend variants differing by under 5 MPa.

parsed.critic: C01, C02 and C06 each differ from their nearest measured mix in 4 to 6 ingredients, and the RF tree SD is about 10 to 12 MPa, so the high predictions could fall well short, for example because of workability or paste-volume effects that the model does not capture.
